{
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "configurations": [
    {
      "name": "Django: Run Server",
      "type": "debugpy",
      "request": "launch",
      "program": "${workspaceFolder}/manage.py",
      "args": [
        "runserver",
        "--noreload"
      ],
      "django": true,
      "justMyCode": true,
      "console": "integratedTerminal"
    },
    {
      "name": "Tailwind: Watch CSS",
      "type": "node",
      "request": "launch",
      "runtimeExecutable": "npm",
      "runtimeArgs": [
        "run",
        "watch:css"
      ],
      "console": "integratedTerminal"
    }
  ],
  "compounds": [
    {
      "name": "Django + Tailwind",
      "configurations": [
        "Django: Run Server",
        "Tailwind: Watch CSS"
      ],
      "stopAll": true
    }
  ]
}

=== WELCOME.md ===
# Welcome to Your Django Project!

## Getting Started

- Opening this folder in VS Code auto-runs `Workspace: Start Dev`, which starts Django and Tailwind in grouped integrated terminals.
- You can manually rerun `Workspace: Start Dev` from the Tasks menu if needed.

## Dev Startup Script
- `start-dev.bat` is generated in the project root.
- It opens a fresh VS Code window for the workspace so the auto-run task can start the dev processes.

## Admin Setup
- `SUPERUSER_SETUP.md` explains how to create a Django superuser manually.
- Prefer the project `.venv` commands from that guide for manual `manage.py` usage unless you have activated the virtual environment.

## Project Structure
- `manage.py` - Django management script
- `templates/` - HTML templates when enabled
- `static/` - Static files
- `my-shop/` - Django project configuration
